status_legend.SOURCED: public evidence directly supports displayed number under specified conditions
status_legend.ASSUMPTION: scenario input, not Meesho disclosure and/or price not independently verified
status_legend.PARTLY_SOURCED: partially grounded, one or more components unverified

fx_inr_per_usd.note: ECB derived USD/INR historical daily rate. Not a forecast.

server_usd.note: Budget for a dual socket server with about 64 physical cores / 128 hardware threads. Excludes separately modelled RAM and bulk storage. Actual configured quotations vary considerably.

server_vcpu.note: Two 32-core CPUs with SMT/Hyper Threading provide 128 logical threads. Assumes one simulated vCPU per logical thread; actual cloud vCPU equivalence depends on workload and processor performance.

server_kw.note: Estimated average IT power draw per compute server, not nameplate power. Requires measurement for a selected configuration.

ram_usd_per_gb.note: Budget range for enterprise server memory, not consumer RAM. The market includes substantially higher OEM configuration prices.

nvme_usd_per_tb.note: Planning prices for enterprise NVMe SSD capacity. Exact values depend on drive endurance, capacity, warranty, interface and procurement volume.

hdd_object_usd_per_raw_tb.note: Enterprise HDD capacity plus an allowance for storage node chassis, controllers and integration. Public 20 TB enterprise HDD listings support approximately USD 42/TB for bare drives.

storage_overhead_factor.note: Ceph 4+2 erasure coding has a raw to usable capacity factor of 1.5. This is a selected architecture, not a disclosed Meesho configuration.

storage_kw_per_raw_tb.note: 1.2 W per raw TB, representing drives plus a limited allocation of storage server overhead. Validate against actual drive and storage node configuration.

network_gear_pct_of_hw.note: Network switching, routing and associated equipment budgeted at 10% of hardware capex. A published data center cost study reports networking at approximately 10% of total development costs, but its cost denominator differs from this simulator.

maintenance_pct_per_year.note: Annual allowance for hardware support, spare parts and replacements. An industry TCO guide provides a broad 5%-8% maintenance range, but this is not a Meesho contract quote.

hardware_life_years.note: Five year economic replacement period for the financial model. Individual server, SSD and HDD replacement cycles can differ.

capacity_headroom.note: Provision 20% above the modelled workload for operational reserve and growth. Does not by itself model failover between data centers.

rack_kw_limit.note: Selected IT power budget per rack. A published Indian provider lists an 8 kW high density rack configuration.

colo_rack_inr_month.note: Indicative Indian full rack retail pricing. Public prices often include power and/or bandwidth; only use as an independent space charge if those bundled costs are removed.

colo_power_inr_kw_month.note: Indicative Indian colocation power related charges, not necessarily metered electricity tariffs. Avoid adding to a rack package that already includes power.

transit_inr_per_mbps_month.note: Wholesale high capacity IP transit planning range. No verified public quote was established for Meesho scale committed internet capacity. CDN charges and bundled bandwidth must be modelled separately.

staff_loaded_inr_month.note: Fully loaded monthly cost per infrastructure engineer/SRE including employer benefits, overhead and on call. This is not a verified Meesho compensation figure.

staff_min.note: Minimum dedicated on prem operations team to cover infrastructure, networking, storage and on call support. Assumes physical data center facilities are managed by the colocation provider.

staff_per_100_servers.note: Conservative labour intensive staffing scenario. Actual ratio depends on automation and fleet design; six engineers per hundred compute servers may substantially overestimate staffing for a hyperscale style deployment.

setup_labour_inr_per_rack.note: One time per rack installation and cabling allowance. A public provider lists initial setup and testing at INR 10,000 to 25,000, but does not establish an identical labour only charge.

on_demand.note: USD 0.202/instance hour divided by four vCPUs, Linux m6i.xlarge in Mumbai, excludes EBS, OS licences, support, tax and non compute charges

commit_1y.note: No upfront standard 1 year RI approx USD 0.1334/instance hour /4, billing commitment and utilization matter, Linux m6i.xlarge in Mumbai, excludes EBS, OS licences, support, tax and non compute charges

commit_3y.note: No upfront standard 3 year RI approx USD 0.0919/instance hour /4, avoid mixing Savings Plans and RIs, Linux m6i.xlarge in Mumbai, excludes EBS, OS licences, support, tax and non compute charges

object_storage_gb_month.note: Indicative S3 Standard Mumbai rate, not independently established from the official region specific pricing table in this research. Does not include requests, retrieval, data transfer, replication or enterprise discounts.

cdn_egress_tiers_india.unit: USD per GB, cumulative thresholds in TB per month, decimal for model compatibility
cdn_egress_tiers_india.note: Original illustrative tiers retained for compatibility. The current AWS CloudFront official page emphasizes flat rate plans and does not confirm these India PAYG tier prices in the inspected page. ALL tier prices must be treated as modelling assumptions until independently verified, enterprise scale discounts are custom negotiated. Rates are marginal by tier, not blended.

cdn_request_per_10k.note: Retains original placeholder, evidence used US/Europe rate, not verified for HTTPS requests to India. Current AWS has flat rate CloudFront options, verify PAYG India request prices separately.

cdn_origin_fill_gb.note: AWS origin to CloudFront data transfer waiver for eligible AWS origin traffic. Does not imply free third party origin egress or zero origin processing/storage requests.

managed_multiplier_cache.note: Illustrative ratio for managed Redis/cache versus a self hosted alternative, loosely motivated by a vendor cost saving case study. Not a market price and not Meesho specific, can double count RAM/compute if applied carelessly.

managed_multiplier_db.note: Illustrative managed database premium relative to raw compute/storage. Database engine, replication, backups, IOPS and licensing cannot be summarized accurately by a universal multiplier.

on_demand.note: n4-standard-4 Mumbai Linux, 0.1887/4 instance hour divided by four vCPUs, commitments assume eligible usage and may change under pricing models

commit_1y.note: n4-standard-4 Mumbai Linux, 0.1189/4 instance hour divided by four vCPUs, commitments assume eligible usage and may change under pricing models

commit_3y.note: n4-standard-4 Mumbai Linux, 0.0849/4 instance hour divided by four vCPUs, commitments assume eligible usage and may change under pricing models

object_storage_gb_month.note: Approx $0.020/GiB month from Google public regional Standard storage table ($0.000027397/GiB hour at 730 hours), but page region selector was not confirmed set to Mumbai, do not label this an independently verified asia south1 SKU. Confirm Mumbai in Google Cloud calculator.

cdn_egress_tiers_india.unit: USD per GiB, monthly volume thresholds in TiB, Asia Pacific destination
cdn_egress_tiers_india.note: Official Asia Pacific cache data transfer out tier table. Above 500 TiB/month contact sales for custom volume discounts, $0.04/GiB is public list tier reference, NOT Meesho effective negotiated price. Destination geography matters.

cdn_request_per_10k.note: Official per 10,000 HTTP/HTTPS cache lookup requests, not all application API requests.

cdn_origin_fill_gb.note: Within Asia Pacific cache fill rate in USD/GiB for eligible origin locations, cross region and external origin rates differ.

managed_multiplier_cache.note: Illustrative ratio for managed Redis/cache versus a self hosted alternative, loosely motivated by a vendor cost saving case study. Not a market price and not Meesho specific, can double count RAM/compute if applied carelessly.

managed_multiplier_db.note: Illustrative managed database premium relative to raw compute/storage. Database engine, replication, backups, IOPS and licensing cannot be summarized accurately by a universal multiplier.

block_ssd_gb_month.note: Shared value retained for model compatibility. AWS Mumbai gp3 list price is $0.0912/GB month (plus extra IOPS/throughput), GCP PD balanced/SSD is a DIFFERENT product/price, so $0.10 is not a sourced common rate. Prefer provider specific rates.

ram_gb_per_vcpu.note: m6i.xlarge and n4-standard-4 both have 16 GiB/4 vCPU. This is the selected VM family ratio, NOT a disclosed Meesho workload wide RAM ratio.
